text.p: BioChem Pharma Inc, whose 3TC/Epivir is the top-selling AIDS drug, expects to report earnings of $0.50 to $0.60 per share for 1996, President and Chief Executive Officer Dr. Francesco Bellini said Tuesday.
Speaking at a Hambrecht and Quist healthcare conference here, Bellini also said he expects full year 1996 sales to reach $300 million.
He said earnings in 1997 will be "much, much, much" better than in 1996.
In 1995 BioChem reported a loss of $0.10 per share on revenues of $179.8 million.
"The growth trend is still very good. We don't see a plateau," Bellini said. "We expect sales to continue to rise next year and the year after."
3TC, which attacks the HIV virus, is a part of 90 percent of all AIDS drug combination therapies, he said.
